name: Ise & Kai: Chosen Throne
source:
How do you fulfill fate if it’s recorded wrong? Forge your destiny as Seina Kaimana, a descendant of the realm's goddess, Adelina, as she fights against a predetermined fate. After discovering there’s more to her destiny, what will she prioritize?

The Kaimana Kingdom and her destiny? Truths about the realm from its demonic side? Or perhaps her own method of change? It’s your choice!
translation:
如果命运记错了，你如何完成命运？扮演塞娜·凯马纳 (Seina Kaimana)，王国女神阿德琳娜 (Adelina) 的后裔，塑造你的命运，与预定的命运作斗争。在发现她的命运还有更多的事情之后，她会优先考虑什么？

凯马纳王国和她的命运？从恶魔的角度来看这个领域的真相？或者也许是她自己的改变方法？这是你的选择！
